meta.title: Coffee Cocoa — Specialty Coffee & Spanish Pastry in Dubai
meta.description: A late-night specialty coffee house in Dubai with artisan pastry from small Spanish bakeries: piononos, churros, torrijas, freshly squeezed Spanish oranges and more.

hero.sub: Single-origin coffee, pastry from small family bakeries in Spain and a warm room that stays lit long after sunset.

story.title: From the obradores of Spain to the heart of Dubai.
story.p1: In Spain, the best pastry still comes from small family workshops, the obradores, where recipes pass from one generation to the next. We travelled the country to find them.
story.p2: Piononos from Santa Fe, almond tarts from Galicia, churros fried to order. Each one is paired with specialty coffee roasted for the espresso bar and served in a room built for slow evenings.
story.quote: Every cup has its origin. Every pastry has its story.
